alt: A short film for Stories, no voice. A dark blue courtyard at night with stars. An amber block figure and a light blue one sit on either side of a round rangoli on the ground; they take turns leaning in, and the rangoli fills ring by ring with petals and dots in coral, yellow, light blue and white. A small clay lamp in the middle lights. The two look at each other with happy eyes. The text stays on screen: if someone sent you this, you are invited to make light together.
